scope: New instantaneous region-size and quarter/window summaries for the accepted576-case pilot. Prior complete physical-field/native-source audit reused; no integrations or lifetime classification.
interpretation: Widths are grid-cell component widths at half current contrast, not interpolated front positions or spatially converged continuum widths.

Largest width contributes once per amplitude-qualified saved profile; second-largest once per qualified multiregion profile. Conditional widths average each contributing seed equally, with per-condition contributors and frame coverage retained.
Scalar organization and widths use different declared cadences (5/.5 versus40/4); widths do not imply continuous event durations, births, lineage or functional competition.
Inclusive full/half/quarter windows are finite-window sensitivity summaries, not proof of equilibrium or stationarity.
The original ten-metric numerical scope does not automatically qualify the new width distribution estimator; these bounded source/geometry/weighting checks establish readout fidelity only.
